summary.executiveSummaryReference: The group discussed several possible responses to residents using visitor parking spaces, including permits, marked bays, barriers, reminder letters and asking the council to adopt the road. Each option had practical drawbacks, especially around enforcement, cost or effectiveness. No solution, decision or owner was agreed, and the issue was effectively deferred until the following month.
